descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · TC-06 Admission Status Toggle · S23 「本地栈上的原生 iOS/Android：点徽章、改它、切到后台再打开；相机扫描进来是 Follow-up；日期错或没设时钟的手机显示同样的徽章」 Native iOS/Android on the local stack: tap the badge, change it, background and reopen; camera scan lands Follow-up; a phone with a wrong date or no clock set shows the same badge

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U4 The physician can change the badge by hand at any time (before or after Generate, and on a patient whose status already rolled) through all three states, and each change persists (list, chart, reload …（UAT TC-06；TFA-92584 AC 1）
  • U2 Every scanned patient defaults to Follow-up (Hospital census-photo scan and Nursing Home resident-list scan)（UAT TC-06；TFA-92584 AC 2）
  • U6 The day roll uses server time, not the device clock: a device with a wrong date, no clock set or another time zone shows the same badge and the same pre-selected template as any other device, and nev …（UAT TC-06；UAT 3.8；TFA-92584 AC 8）
  • U12 All of the above works in both Hospital and Nursing Home (step 7, ground rule 3.3)（UAT TC-06；UAT 3.3；TFA-92584 AC 7）

测试设计方法：设备（device） — 在手机尺寸或真机（iPhone / Pixel）上看布局和手势。

Given Android: the debug build of main e02167f bundled for the local stack (scripts/android-lane.ts: adb reverse tcp:4510/4511 on AVD rc_api36, or a USB phone with the same reverse). iOS: a local Xcode build of main pointed at the local stack. Second device: the web app on Vite 6473. …

When Tap the chart badge and pick each state in the native picker, background the app and reopen; photograph a printed census and a resident list; then set the phone's date one day back and set a patient and a resident to New Admission on the phone; …

Then The native picker offers the three states; the choice persists after reopening; every scanned patient is Follow-up; with the phone's clock wrong or unset, the phone and the web device show the same badge and Note Format pre-selection, and what the phone set still reads New Admission on the web device

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：Same as the S01/S02/S05 checkpoints, judged by a person. UAT 3.8 'Test with one device set to the wrong date' + TFA-92584 AC 8: on main the phone's day decides, so the clock cells are expected to Fail (known: TFA-92584 AC 8). 3.9: record the vision model

在哪跑：dev；测试方法 DEVICE · 真机（iOS / Android）；矩阵里排的车道 人工（manual）

S23 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-06.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

环境：dev — dev 部署，build e02167f（Deploy Convex，2026-10-12T18:24:27Z）；账号和地址不写进报告；run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev。

测试方法：DEVICE · 真机（iOS / Android） — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 both (local debug build, or store build on dev) 跑；来源：dev。
